messages.subject: Firefox issues...
parts:
I've noticed that shiny running in firefox 26 runs slower than chrome Version 32.0.1700.72 on Widows 7.  (In larger examples, graphs take 5 seconds to refresh on firefox compared to sub 1 second in chrome)

For the record, I'm serving out shiny via the R console using shiny::runApp

While looking into this I came across something interesting.  It looks like firefox has issues loading shiny webpages that are served out via the R console using shiny::runApp

For the sake of simplicity, I will use the following height weight example:

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/heightweight/

Using Firebug to see how Firefox loads this, glimmer seem to work out well.  No red "Get null 404 not found"

However, if I serve the page out from the R console, Firebug seems to show an error:  "Get null 404 not found"

Please refer to the images included.

Could this be related to Firefox running slow compared to Chrome?  (Chrome seems to run fine in both cases.)
